sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 78 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. This standing-start run begins at the first paired edge station and ends at the last; original timing metadata are retained. Finish speed is unconstrained, with no stopping zone modelled. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Road edges observed at approximately 36 m intervals on the pinned LGLN DOP20 image. The inner feature denotes driver-left and outer denotes driver-right along the saved open trace. Limits follow the visible paved road edge, excluding grass shoulders, farm aprons and side roads. Three right-edge farm openings have no asserted edge observations and interpolate between neighbouring anchors. Distinct first/last measured cross-sections define this standing-start simulation, not surveyed timing endpoints or a stopping zone. Sparse intervals, raster spacing and shadows limit accuracy; banking is unknown and rendered curbs illustrative.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
